Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose to not digivolve. In such cases, you shuffle all of the searched cards and return them to the security stack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to search my security stack but choose to not digivolve?

Card Q&A.a: You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve. A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules. After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.
Card Q&A.q: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the security stack?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If it's your turn, search your security stack. This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Angel] or [Three Great Angels] trait among them with the digivolution cost reduced by 2. Then, shuffle your security stack. If this effect digivolved, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait from the hand at the bottom of your security stack.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.
